newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson to offer 30 mln shrs in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Henderson to offer 30 mln shrs in Tokyo.

text.p: Henderson Land Developement Co Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to offer 30 million shares, or 1.73 percent of its enlarged issued share capital, in a proposed secondary listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The company said in a statement that the issue price of the new shares would be fixed at a later date. It said the shares would not be issued at a discount of more than three percent to the closing price of its shares in Hong Kong at a date closer to the offering.
The Japan offering is expected to take place in the next few weeks and dealing in the shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange is due to begin in early February, Henderson Land said.
The exact number of new shares, issue price and other terms would be agreed later, it said. Net proceeds would be used for general funding purposes.

Henderson Land said it had begun the necessary applications and filings to the Japanese Minister of Finance and the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The offering was subject to finalisation of certain terms and the relevant approvals by the Japanese Ministry and Tokyo and Hong Kong stock exchanges.
Henderson Land said it would be the first Hong Kong company to obtain a secondary listing in Japan.
Shares of the Hong Kong blue chip property developer closed HK$0.25 lower on Monday at HK$72.00.
